audit.why: 51.57% over 287 games with the swing at level 11 is exactly what the chart says: Camille owns levels 2-10 against a melee, dashless Kayle and loses the duel once Divine Ascent turns her ranged. Levels 1 and 6 stay Skill because both are one-ability openings / both get an ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-11 spike was credited to 'Kayle's E'. Her ranged attacks come from her passive, Divine Ascent. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an on-hit magic proc and an attack reset - it has nothing to do with attack range.
audit.why: Riot, Divine Ascent (P): 'Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points... she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range.' Riot, Starfire Spellblade (E): 'Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage.'
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, late and whys[6] now credit Divine Ascent (P) for the level-11 range, and Divine Judgment's real 160/120/80s cooldown is named so 'walk away on its cooldown' means something.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions that decide this lane were absent: Celestial Blessing (W) heals her on a flat 15s cooldown, and Starfire Spellblade (E, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s) is an auto-attack reset, so her burst opens on an attack wind-up rather than a cast. Camille's Hookshot was also called a stun; Riot's text says it knocks up.
audit.why: Riot: Celestial Blessing - 'Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.' Starfire Spellblade - 'Kayle's next attack smites her target.' Camille's Hookshot - 'leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.' _missing-interactions.json flags both needs-antiheal and autoreset-burst-tell for this pairing.
audit.corrected: early adds Radiant Blast's 12s window and the Celestial Blessing heal; mid adds the Starfire Spellblade reset tell and the Grievous Wounds call; every Hookshot 'stun' becomes a knock-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal call anywhere, despite Celestial Blessing being her only way to survive your extended melee-form trades.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal at every rank, so it comes back inside a single lane cycle; Grievous Wounds is what turns your run-down into a kill instead of a reset.
audit.corrected: mid now buys Grievous Wounds against Celestial Blessing before the level-11 window closes.

edits.before: This is the turn: Kayle's E unlocks ranged basic attacks, so she finally out-ranges your melee kit. Every fight before this is yours; after it the lane inverts.
edits.after: This is the turn: Divine Ascent (P) hands her ranged basic attacks at 11, so she finally out-ranges your melee kit. Every fight before this is yours; after it the lane inverts.

edits.before: Kayle is a hard scaler and this becomes her game at Level 11 - her E unlocks ranged basic attacks, so once she hits ranged form with two items she kites your E cooldown, pokes you out before you can close, and pops Divine Judgment to survive your R window entirely. You do not win this 1v1 anymore, full stop. Your only path is the lead you built before 11: split early, take her tower and plates, and end the game before her ranged DPS and team-wide R take over fights. If it goes long, let your team peel and don't dive a Kayle who can just press R for invulnerability.

edits.after: Hold Divine Judgment for your all-in to negate the burst, then walk away while it sits on 160s at rank 1

edits.before: Kayle is meleed and escapeless at Levels 1-2, but so are you with just Q, so the opening is a wash - last-hit at range and don't burn E chasing a fight you can't finish yet. Start Q (Precision Protocol) for the empowered second-hit poke, or W (Tactical Sweep) for the outer-edge slash and heal, and respect that her Q slow lets her stack passive autos on you if you walk up carelessly. Don't extend past your Adaptive Defense shield window - once that passive shield is on cooldown your raw HP falls behind her autos and Q pokes. Hold your real all-in for Level 3 when E is online.
edits.after: Kayle is meleed and escapeless at Levels 1-2, but so are you with just Q, so the opening is a wash - last-hit at range and don't burn E chasing a fight you can't finish yet. Start Q (Precision Protocol) for the empowered second-hit poke, or W (Tactical Sweep) for the outer-edge slash and heal, and step up the moment Radiant Blast (Q, 12s) misses - that slow is what lets her stack passive autos on you. Don't extend past your Adaptive Defenses shield window; once that passive shield is on cooldown your raw HP falls behind her autos, and Celestial Blessing (W, 15s) refunds the chip you did. Hold your real all-in for Level 3.

edits.before: This is your whole lane - Levels 3 through 10. Kayle is still in melee form with no dash and no escape: E-wall-stun in, land W's outer edge for the max-HP damage and self-heal, then weave the empowered second Q for true damage to delete her. Bait or out-wait Divine Judgment first - once that invulnerability is committed she's defenseless, so save your hard commit for that window. At 6 your Hextech Ultimatum traps her in an arena with no exit for a clean isolated 1v1, but remember she gets her R at 6 too, so only cash in once it's down. Every level she survives drags her toward level 11 and the ranged form that beats you.
edits.after: This is your whole lane - Levels 3 through 10. Kayle is still in melee form with no dash and no escape: E in off a wall for the knock-up, land W's outer edge for the max-HP damage and self-heal, then weave the empowered second Q for true damage to delete her. Her burst opens on Starfire Spellblade (E, 8s), an auto-attack reset - the attack wind-up is the tell, not a cast bar. Bait or out-wait Divine Judgment first; once that invulnerability is committed she's defenseless. Buy Grievous Wounds early, because Celestial Blessing (W, flat 15s) refunds every extended trade you win. At 6 your Hextech Ultimatum traps her with no exit, but she gets her R at 6 too.

notes: The level-11 range spike being blamed on Kayle's E instead of Divine Ascent is the kind of error that makes a player skill her E to check - it was repeated in three places. 'Adaptive Defense' (singular) also appeared in early; Camille's passive is Adaptive Defenses. Kayle's Radiant Blast reduces resistances, which is worth nothing against your Q recast because that hit is true damage - I did not write a line about it since a non-interaction is filler. I did NOT claim whether Divine Judgment's invulnerability breaks The Hextech Ultimatum's anchor or merely survives it: the kit files do not say and a player would bet a game on that answer. Logged as unverified.
